svg.text: AREG TOY — FULL ELECTRICAL SCHEMATIC (rev A) — single 3.3 V rail

text.tspan: AREG TOY — SHEET 1/5 — POWER TREE (single 3V3 rail)
Rule: every chemistry crosses 3.3 V during discharge → buck-boost is mandatory;
a plain buck drops out below ~3.4 V in, an LDO (AMS1117, 1.1 V dropout) needs ≥4.4 V in.
AREG TOY — SHEET 5/5 — USB-C INPUT AND PROTECTION
D+/D− → USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array → GPIO19/20 (or factory pogo pads only).
10 kΩ pull-ups→3V3 on CS, CMD, DAT0, DAT1, DAT2
(floating DAT1/2 can flip the card out of SPI mode)
to VDD or GND per test
LED: WS2812B on 5 V needs SN74LVC1T45 level shifter (VIH=3.5 V > ESP VOH);
on a 3V3-only build use 3 discrete LEDs at 2–3 mA (size R from the VF curve).
